unit: WF4 Approval Gate treats an approval that is no longer PENDING as a DUPLICATE, not a fresh decision
description: A decision that names an approval row whose status is not PENDING must return gate DUPLICATE, because a second decision on an already-decided approval is a duplicate, never a new decision. It must not reach the derivation block, so no send identity is emitted.
why_it_exists: Gate check step 3 of wf4/approval-gate.js converts an approval already acted on into a DUPLICATE refusal. The delivery-key families only ever supplied PENDING approvals, so the not-PENDING path was unasserted. This pins that a decided approval cannot be re-decided into a send, and that the decision and decided_at facts are carried in the refusal reason.

drafts.content: Our client requires the vehicle inspection report referred to in your letter of 14 January.

expect.note: The approval row was decided the previous day; a second decision on it is a duplicate, not a fresh APPROVE.

assertions: an approval whose status is APPROVED (not PENDING) returns gate DUPLICATE
the refusal records the prior decision and its decided_at so the reason is self-explanatory to the owner
dry_run is normalised to the boolean true and passed through on the refusal
Config keys survive the refusal untouched
no delivery identity is emitted on a refusals path that stopped before the derivation block
